workers.existing_capabilities: Central append-only history, durable delivery, projected observations, coverage and source failure/recovery notice
rules: Observation time is not action time
Initial snapshot is not a historical change
Unconnected physical settings and app actions remain unmonitored

workers.existing_capabilities: Scale collection, evidence and central publication
rules: Never sum cumulative snapshots as production
Retain device identity and time-bounded store assignment
Do not infer sales from scale output
Print is not attachment or sale
Preserve multiple discount stages; do not stack them blindly

workers.existing_capabilities: Sales import, validation and Supabase ingest
rules: Monthly cumulative snapshots are not additive

workers.existing_capabilities: OCR, total validation and Supabase ingest
inputs: Daeyoung source images and OCR rows
rules: Preserve original image and stated/calculated totals
Gross = net / 0.785 only for confirmed 21.5 percent fee basis

workers.existing_capabilities: Domain guides and manual reporting workflow
rules: Stores are dimensions, not separate worker implementations
Isolate uncertain records and process remaining data

processing_rules: Persist raw input before advancing checkpoints
Deduplicate by source identity and revision; preserve changed content as a new version
Commit outputs and checkpoints atomically or through a replay-safe transactional outbox
Late data and corrections recompute only affected store/date/product ranges
Retry transient collection failures; quarantine malformed records without dropping them
Never reuse these retry rules to resend uncertain physical scale writes
Event-driven processing with periodic catch-up; frequency and host selected at deployment
Track checkpoint, data time, last success, errors, pending and quarantined counts separately
